title: AI Automation Expert
description:
We build operational infrastructure for marketing agencies. Our clients are founders doing £15K to £150K a month who want their agencies to run without them. Through our six month programme, the Agency Operating Room, we install systems, AI agents, and delivery workflows directly into their backends.



We’re looking for someone who lives inside AI tools and can turn process into product.



What you’ll actually be doing



Building AI agents from our library of 350+ SOPs. Each one converts a documented process into a working agent that runs inside a client’s business.



Designing and shipping automated workflows across the major agency functions (sales, delivery, finance, ops, team).



Building the monitoring layer that gives founders oversight without involvement.



Owning the AI skill library as a proprietary product. This is core IP, not a side project.

Working directly with me on what gets built next, then executing it end to end.



Who you are



You’ve already built AI agents and workflows that solve real business problems. Not prototypes. Things that run in production.

You know your way around the main tools (n8n, Make, Zapier, OpenAI, Claude, custom builds where needed). You’re not married to a stack.



You can read a messy SOP, spot the logic, and turn it into something that runs without a human.



You move fast and ship. You’d rather build, test, iterate than spend three weeks scoping.

You’ve worked in or around agencies before. Bonus if you understand what client delivery actually looks like inside one.



What this isn’t



A junior automation role. A “VA who knows ChatGPT” role. A theoretical AI consultant role.

You’re building the operational backbone of a programme that’s already running, with clients already paying, and a library of IP that needs deploying at speed.



How we work

Remote. Async by default with weekly syncs. Output over hours. We don’t track time, we track shipped.



To apply

Send me a Loom (max 5 minutes) walking through one AI agent or workflow you’ve built end to end. Tell me what it does, why you built it that way, and what you’d do differently now.

title: Personal Brand
description:
The Vision — Read This First



I am going to be honest with you because I believe the right person for this role needs to understand what they are stepping into.



I am building more than a YouTube channel. I am documenting a life mission — from the very beginning, raw and unfiltered.

I am at the start of my e-commerce journey right now. Not at the top looking back. Not telling you a success story. I am at day one, and that is exactly the point. My life purpose, the thing I believe God put me on this earth to do, is to build an e-commerce company that I will grow and eventually exit for at least $500 million — and use that money to fund a charity that does real, lasting good for people and for this planet.



That is not a fantasy. That is the plan. And I am going to document every single step — from the very first sale to the final exit. The wins, the failures, the sleepless nights, the breakthroughs, the lessons — all of it, completely raw and unfiltered. No highlight reel. No pretending to have it figured out. Just the real journey as it happens, so that others can learn from it, be inspired by it, and maybe find their own purpose along the way.



This content will run for the next 20 to 30 years. You are not joining a finished product — you are joining at the ground floor of something that will grow into something massive. And I need someone by my side who does not just edit videos but who truly believes in this mission and wants to help bring it to life.



I am not looking for a freelancer who edits a few clips and moves on. I am looking for a creative partner — someone who will grow with me from the very beginning, who will help shape how the world sees this journey, and who will one day look back and say: "I was there from day one. I helped build that."

title: Social Media Video Editor & Content Creator
description:
About AT Media Partners

AT Media Partners (ATMP) is a performance marketing agency based in Australia and New

Zealand, specialising in Meta 
 and Instagram) lead generation for trades and home

services businesses — think roofers, landscapers, concreters, painters, pool builders, and

fencers.

We run high-converting ad campaigns for our clients and are building a strong organic content

arm to grow the agency brand, attract new clients, and establish Aaron (our founder) as the goto authority in the trades marketing space.

This is a growing, fast-moving team. We move quickly, hold high standards, and reward people

who take ownership. If you like being told exactly what to do every step of the way, this is not

the role for you. If you like having real creative input and seeing your work go live to thousands

of people, read on.

The Role

We are looking for a skilled video editor and content creator who can handle two distinct

workstreams:

1. Client Deliverables

You will edit and produce video ads and static image ads for our trade clients. These include:

• Talking head video ads — clients speak to camera, you handle cutting, captions, music,

colour grading, and B-roll inserts

• B-roll compilation clips — sourcing, cutting, and stitching footage into polished short-form

ads

• Testimonial, showcase, and transformation video edits — structured formats that follow our

agency brief templates

• AI-enhanced video content — using AI tools (Runway, CapCut AI, or similar) to elevate raw

footage

• Static image ad creatives — clean, conversion-focused graphics for Meta ad sets (Canva

or Adobe)

2. Agency Brand Content

You will also drive the organic content output for the ATMP brand and Aaron's personal brand:

• Short-form video editing for Instagram Reels,
, and YouTube Shorts to attract

potential trade clients

• Content direction — reviewing raw footage from Aaron and turning it into structured,

thumb-stopping content

• Concept ideation — proactively bringing new content ideas relevant to the trades marketing

audience

• Website visuals and landing page graphics to support organic and paid traffic

• Branding assets — maintaining and evolving the ATMP visual identity across all content

formats

What You Will Work On Day-to-Day

• Receive video briefs via Monday.com and deliver edits to a clear deadline

• Edit 2 to 5 client video ads per week depending on campaign volume

• Produce 3 to 5 short-form agency content pieces per week for organic channels

• Collaborate with the CSM team to ensure client video briefs match what was promised

• Attend a brief weekly check-in call to align on priorities and upcoming shoots

• Suggest new content formats, hooks, and creative angles proactively — not just waiting to

be briefed

Tools You Should Know

You do not need all of these, but strong command of most is expected:

• CapCut (essential for fast turnaround short-form content)

• Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve (for higher production client ads)

• Canva (for static image ads and agency graphics)

• Adobe Photoshop or Illustrator (preferred, not required)

• AI video tools such as Runway ML, CapCut AI, or Pika (strong advantage)

• Monday.com or similar project management tools (we use Monday for all task tracking)

Behaviour Requirements

This section matters as much as the skills. We have a tight team and need someone who fits

the culture.

• Fast and reliable — you meet deadlines without being chased. If something comes up, you

communicate early.

• Takes a brief and runs with it — you do not need the client hand-held through every

decision. You read the brief, ask one clarifying question if needed, and deliver.

• Ego-free — you receive feedback with professionalism and iterate quickly. The work is

what matters, not being right.

• Platform-aware — you understand what actually performs on Instagram,
, and

YouTube Shorts in 2025. You are not just making things look pretty; you are making things

that stop the scroll and convert.

• Proactive — you bring ideas to the table. You notice what is trending, what competitors are

doing, what types of content would work for the ATMP brand, and you flag it.

• Detail-oriented — captions are spelt correctly, colours match brand guidelines, files are

delivered in the right format, and nothing goes out looking sloppy.

• Organised — you track your own workload, update your task status, and flag when you are

blocked. You do not let things fall through the cracks.

What We Are NOT Looking For

• Editors who only work from fully produced scripts and footage with zero creative input

• People who take days to respond to messages or miss deadlines without notice

• Generalists who edit everything but specialise in nothing — we need someone strong in

short-form social video specifically

• People who treat every piece of feedback as a personal attack

What Success Looks Like in This Role

After 30 days, you are delivering client video ads on time with minimal revision rounds. After 60

days, you are proactively suggesting content ideas and formats we have not tried yet. After 90

days, you are a core part of the creative output of this agency and clients are commenting on

the quality of their videos.

Compensation and Hours

• Starting engagement: Part-time (10 to 20 hours per week), with the potential to move fulltime as volume grows

• Rate: Negotiable based on experience and portfolio — please include your rate in your

application

• Timezone: AU or NZ timezone strongly preferred, or significant overlap with AEST

• Location: Fully remote

How to Apply

To be considered, your application must include all of the following. Applications missing any of

these will not be reviewed.

? A portfolio or showreel with at least 3 examples of short-form social video edits (Reels or

similar)

? At least 1 example of a video ad or talking head edit

? A short paragraph (3 to 5 sentences) explaining why you are the right fit for this specific

role — not a generic cover letter

? Your hourly or fixed rate and your timezone

? Start your application with the phrase 'I have read the brief' so we know you have read this

in full

Shortlisted applicants will be sent a paid test task before any formal offer is made.

We are looking to move quickly on this. If your work is strong, expect to hear back within

48 hours.

BONUS POINTS:

 Messenger at scale

THE PROCESS:

title: Short-Form Video Editor – High Volume ($2.50/video)
description:
About the Role:

I'm looking for 3 video editors who are fast, comfortable with their editing software, and ready to work at scale. This is a simple, repeatable editing job — not complex creative work. If you can move quickly and follow clear rules, this can be very lucrative.



What You'll Do:

You'll receive raw podcast videos (landscape MP4, straight from YouTube). Your job is to transform each one into a clean 9:16 vertical video ready for the next step of the editing process. That's it — everything else (B-roll, subtitles, music, filters, watermark) is handled after you.



I provide everything. You grab the MP4 file, edit it following the rules I give you, send it back — and you get paid.



Editing Rules (Simple & Clear)



Each video requires:



- Convert to 9:16 format with the speaker's face centered

- Craft a strong hook (first 2.5 seconds)

- Clean cuts — remove silences, filler words, repetitions, anything that doesn't move the story forward

- Add a subtle zoom effect throughout

- Audio enhancement only if needed (rare)

- Export as MP4 only



No B-roll. No subtitles. No music. No filters. No watermark.



Pay:

$2.50 per edited video, paid after my validation.



There is no cap — the faster and more consistently you work, the more you earn. Editors who can handle volume will make serious money with this.

- Comfortable and fast with your editing software (CapCut, Premiere, DaVinci, or similar)

title: **UNIQUE ROLE** Fast-paced, reliable, experienced Executive / Personal Operations Assistant (remote, long-term)
description:
## About Me



I’m a UK-based surgeon, researcher, university academic, and founder working across medicine, AI, education, and healthcare innovation.



My work includes:

- Clinical surgery and academic medicine

- AI and digital health startups

- Medical education platforms

- Research and grant applications

- Speaking, writing, and international collaborations



I’m looking for a highly organised, intelligent, trustworthy, experienced remote assistant who can become a long-term operational partner across both professional and personal life.



This is NOT a generic “VA task” role.



Over time, I’d like this person to become deeply integrated into helping organise projects, communications, workflows, scheduling, research operations, travel, and life admin.



I have two young children and a wife who also works. I don’t want to scale back my professional ambition and need the help of the right EA/PA to reduce friction in my life.



---



## What You’ll Help With



1. Executive organisation and calendar management



* Manage and maintain a complex professional and personal calendar.

* Schedule meetings across multiple time zones with academics, clinicians, collaborators, founders, funders and family contacts.

* Protect focused work blocks for writing, strategy, research, business development and exam preparation.

* Prepare a weekly planning brief summarising upcoming meetings, deadlines, decisions and priorities.

* Create daily or weekly “decision lists” showing which items need direct input.



2. Inbox and communications support



* Triage
 inboxes and categorise messages by urgency, importance and required action.

* Draft professional replies in a warm, concise and polished tone.

* Chase outstanding replies, documents, signatures and meeting confirmations.

* Maintain a “waiting on” tracker for collaborators, suppliers, partners and professional contacts.

* Prepare templated responses for common requests.

* Identify
s requiring urgent personal attention.



3. Research and academic administration



* Maintain manuscript, grant, ethics and project trackers.

* Chase co-authors and collaborators for comments, approvals and documents.

* Format manuscripts, references, author lists, tables and submission documents.

* Prepare journal submission packs including cover letters, COI forms and supplementary files.

* Track grant and fellowship deadlines.

* Research funder eligibility, submission requirements and timelines.

* Prepare meeting agendas, minutes and action logs for research projects.

* Maintain an up-to-date academic CV, publication list, ORCID/Google Scholar summary and biography.



4. Startup and business operations



* Support operations across several early-stage digital health, medical education and AI-related ventures.

* Maintain CRM lists of partners, customers, advisors, investors, collaborators and prospects.

* Conduct structured competitor research and pricing comparisons.

* Prepare market maps, lead lists and outreach spreadsheets.

* Draft outreach
s to potential customers, partners, collaborators and funders.

* Track website, domain, subscription, software and renewal dates.

* Monitor analytics, testimonials, user feedback and business KPIs.

* Convert voice notes and rough ideas into structured action plans.



5. Content, education and course support



* Help prepare newsletters, LinkedIn posts, blog drafts and course materials.

* Format educational resources, worksheets, checklists and slide outlines.

* Upload and organise content on websites or learning platforms.

* Manage webinar logistics including registration, Zoom links, reminders and feedback forms.

* Collect testimonials and user feedback.

* Maintain mailing lists and basic CRM workflows.

* Repurpose long-form content into shorter posts, summaries or
 updates.



6. Travel, events and conference logistics



* Research and compare flights, hotels, transfers and car hire.

* Prepare full travel itineraries with booking references, timings, maps and contact details.

* Manage conference registration, abstract deadlines and accommodation options.

* Track receipts and organise travel expenses.

* Liaise with university or institutional travel providers where required.

* Identify family-friendly travel options when needed.

* Create checklists for recurring travel and conference workflows.



7. Personal and household administration



* Support family and household life admin.

* Research and book cleaners, gardeners, handymen, decorators and other household services.

* Compare quotes for household projects and repairs.

* Arrange family activities, childcare options, holiday clubs and travel logistics.

* Manage online orders, returns, refunds and customer service issues.

* Prepare shopping lists or online grocery baskets when requested.

* Help maintain a family calendar for school dates, birthdays, appointments and important events.

* Research thoughtful gifts, cards, restaurants and family experiences.



8. Document, systems and process management



* Create and maintain organised Google Drive folders.

* Keep documents clearly named, version-controlled and easy to find.

* Build simple templates for
s, meeting notes, travel plans, grant trackers and project dashboards.

* Maintain task systems in Notion, Trello, Asana, ClickUp or Google Sheets.

* Turn messy notes, transcripts or voice memos into clean summaries and action points.

* Create repeatable workflows so recurring tasks become easier over time.



9. Light research and briefing work



* Research people, organisations, companies, competitors, grants, events and opportunities.

* Prepare concise briefing notes before meetings.

* Summarise articles, webpages, reports or documents into key points.

* Identify relevant contacts and opportunities in healthcare, academia, startups and medical education.

* Produce simple comparison tables to support decisions.



10. Confidentiality and discretion



* Handle personal, professional and commercial information with absolute discretion.

* Maintain clear boundaries around sensitive clinical, patient, financial or confidential material.

* Follow agreed access rules for inboxes, files, calendars and private documents.

* Escalate anything sensitive, unclear or high-risk before taking action



### AI & Systems

I use AI heavily (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, loveable, automation tools, digital workflows), so enthusiasm for learning AI tools is a major advantage.

## The Kind of Person I’m Looking For



### Essential Qualities

- Excellent written English

- Highly organised

- Reliable and responsive

- Strong attention to detail

- Able to work independently

title: Cold Caller
description:
Cold Caller (Outbound Sales)



Salary: $700–$800 USD per month (Full-Time, Remote)



Overview: We are looking for an energetic Cold Calling Specialist to join our real estate acquisitions team. In this role, you will make a high volume of outbound calls to homeowners and gauge their interest in selling their property. Your daily target will be ~150 calls (and up to 250–300 calls on days we use a multi-line dialer). You’ll follow a proven script to identify motivated sellers, handle initial objections, and transfer hot leads to our acquisitions team. This is a key role that requires excellent spoken English and a friendly, persistent attitude.



Responsibilities:

High-Volume Outbound Calling: Make at least 150 calls per day to targeted property owners using our click-to-dial system. (On certain campaigns with a multi-line dialer, you may dial 250–300 numbers a day.) Maintain a positive, professional demeanor throughout all calls.





Lead Qualification: Follow our prepared script to introduce our company and ask key questions about the homeowner’s interest in selling. Listen actively to identify motivation, timeline, and property details.





Overcome Objections: Professionally handle common pushbacks (“Not interested,” “How did you get my number?” etc.) with polite and confident responses. Stay resilient and upbeat even after repeated rejections – it often takes dozens of “no’s” to get a “yes.”





Record Keeping: Update call outcomes in our CRM in real time. Mark leads as interested, not interested, wrong number, etc., and add any relevant notes from the conversation. Accuracy in tagging call results is crucial for follow-up.





Target Achievement: Strive to meet or exceed weekly and monthly goals, such as number of leads (interested sellers) generated, appointments set, or transfers to the sales team. Work with the team to continuously improve performance (e.g. refining the script or call approach based on feedback).





Requirements:

Excellent English & Neutral Accent: Fluent spoken English with a neutral or minimal accent. You should be easily understood by American homeowners. (We will request a voice recording or conduct a phone screening to verify this.)





Cold Calling Experience: At least 1 year of experience in outbound calling/telesales, telemarketing, or a related role. Experience calling US-based customers or real estate cold calling is a big plus.





Resilience & Energy: Positive attitude and ability to handle rejection. You can make hundreds of calls and still keep an enthusiastic tone. Self-motivated and driven to reach targets.





Tech Requirements: Comfortable using auto-dialer software and CRM systems. (Experience with tools like Mojo Dialer or CallTools, and Podio or a similar CRM, is helpful.) Must have a reliable high-speed internet connection, a quality headset, and a quiet workspace for making calls.





Schedule: Availability to work U.S. business hours (e.g. 9am–5pm Eastern or Central Time). This may be overnight if you live in a different timezone – please ensure you can commit to these hours long-term.





What We Offer:

Competitive Base Pay + Bonus: Base salary of $700–$800/month, with performance bonuses for each deal closed from the leads you generate (we love to reward results!).





Training & Support: Ongoing training in effective cold calling techniques, real estate knowledge, and scripts. You’ll have team support and coaching to help you succeed.





Growth Opportunities: This is a long-term position. Top performers can take on greater responsibilities over time or grow into other roles (e.g. Lead Manager or Team Lead).





Team Culture: Join a friendly, results-driven team. We celebrate wins and learn from losses together. Your contributions will be valued as an important part of our acquisitions process.





Remote Work: Work from home and save commute time. We just ask for reliable attendance and communication during work hours.





How to Apply: To be considered, please send your resume and a voice recording (1-2 minutes) introducing yourself. In the recording, briefly tell us about your cold calling experience or read a few lines from a script to showcase your accent and energy. You may use a free service like Vocaroo and share the link. Applications without a voice sample will not be reviewed, since speaking ability is crucial for this role. We will invite promising candidates for a live interview and mock call. Excited to hear from you – let’s hit those dialing goals together!

title: Paralegal/Attorney – Criminal Defense
description:
Position Overview:

We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Paralegal or Attorney to support our criminal defense practice. This role requires in-depth knowledge of criminal law, including motion preparation, legal research, and document management. The ideal candidate will be responsible for preparing motions, drafting legal documents, and ensuring compliance with legal procedures. They will work closely with attorneys to ensure the defense strategy is executed effectively, and help prepare cases for court. This is a remote position requiring exceptional written English, organizational skills, and a strong grasp of U.S. criminal law procedures fundamentals.



Key Responsibilities:



• Draft, review, and be prepared to file various legal documents including motions, briefs, and memoranda.

• Prepare appendices for motions, including organizing exhibits, declarations, and supporting documentation.

• Prepare the table of contents for legal filings, ensuring accuracy and compliance with court rules.

• Conduct in-depth legal research on complex criminal law issues and generate a research summary for the attorney.

• Analyze discovery materials to identify critical issues and inconsistencies.

• Prepare memoranda and case summaries to aid in litigation strategy.

• Assist in the preparation of motions for hearings, trials, and appeals, including motions to suppress evidence, dismiss charges, or modify bail.

• Manage case files, ensuring all relevant documents and evidence are properly documented and stored.

• Prepare discovery responses, subpoenas, and other legal documents as directed.

• Coordinate with clients, witnesses, and experts to gather information and evidence for cases.

• Maintain communication with the court, opposing counsel, and clients regarding motions, hearings, and court dates.

• Provide support during trial preparation, including organizing exhibits, trial briefs, and witness lists.

• Ensure all legal documents comply with applicable state and federal rules and deadlines.



Qualifications:

title: Outsourced Team Operations Manager
description:
We run outsourced sales teams for clients across North America, Europe, and Oceania. We are good at it. But good only stays good when someone owns the engine room, and we are looking for that person.

About us

We are a growing outsourcing agency that places and manages remote teams for clients across insurance, digital marketing, real estate, and more. Our teams are based in the Philippines and work directly with Western clients as telesales reps, SDRs, virtual assistants, and social media managers. We are sales-first. 90% of what we do is outbound. We move fast, we expect a lot, and when things go wrong (they do), we fix them and move on.



About the role

You are the bridge between our clients, our leadership, and the outsourced teams on the ground. When a new client comes on board, you get the team set up, plugged into their tools, and shadow the first couple of days to make sure everything clicks. Once they are running, you watch closely: attendance, call quality, coaching, cover. When we hire someone new, you run their onboarding from day one. And when a client or team member needs a firm conversation, you have it.



This role is not quiet. Clients are demanding, teams need managing, and no two days look the same. After 12 months in this seat, you will have built tighter onboarding systems, reduced team issues before they reach leadership, and become the person both clients and team members trust to sort things out.



What you will own

• Client onboarding: Get new clients' outsourced teams set up fast: tools access, CRMs, VoIPs, scripts, shadowing. Clients often don't know their own stack well. You need to know it better than they do.

• Multi-industry adaptability: Our clients span insurance, marketing, real estate, and more. You get up to speed fast on new industries, tools, and team dynamics. This is not optional.

• Team management: Monitor attendance, listen to calls, give real feedback, arrange cover, and hold people to standards. You don't escalate everything. You handle most of it yourself.

• Staff onboarding: When we hire new team members, you run them through our culture, comms standards (EOD reports, response times, punctuality), and get them fully set up from day one.

• Coaching and performance: Spot weak spots in team members and act on them: a training session, a direct conversation, or a flag to leadership.

• Cross-sell and upsell: You will be speaking with clients regularly. When you spot an opportunity to grow the relationship, take it. Incentives are available for those who do.



What we are looking for

Required

• Experience managing remote or outsourced teams of 20+ people, ideally in a sales, BPO, or digital agency environment

• Confident and comfortable speaking with Western clients across North America, Europe, and Oceania, at any level

• Not afraid of difficult conversations. If a team member is not performing or a client is upset, you address it directly

• Deeply organised. You track everything, follow up on everything, and don't let things fall through the cracks

• Comfortable working US hours, including graveyard shift. This is a core part of the role and non-negotiable

• Genuine understanding of what motivates Filipino workers and how to lead, coach, and hold people accountable in a way that actually works

• Comfortable with confrontation when the situation calls for it: not aggressive, but not a pushover either

• Experience with a range of sales and ops tools, for example HubSpot, Go High Level, Pipedrive, CloudTalk, Ooma. You pick up new platforms quickly



Nice to have

• Background in outbound sales or SDR management

• Experience managing multiple client accounts simultaneously

• Familiarity with hiring and shortlisting candidates

• Experience identifying upsell or cross-sell opportunities with existing clients

title: L2 - Junior Virtual Assistant (B2B Account Ops & AR Admin)
description:
Growe Supply | Remote | Full-Time | $350-400/month starting



1. The Opportunity in 30 Seconds



We're hiring someone who will become the operational backbone of our B2B wholesale sales team. You'll handle every admin and follow-up task that keeps our B2B accounts running smoothly—payment reminders, order confirmations, invoicing, AR tracking, and CRM maintenance—so our Account Executive can focus 100% on acquiring and growing wholesale accounts. You'll also be the first point of administrative contact for our B2B clients, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks between a sale and a settled invoice. We have a structured 5-level career path with clear promotion criteria for top performers.



This works if: You're detail-obsessed, a clear written communicator, and want to learn how B2B wholesale operations actually work from the inside.



This doesn't work if: You want to do sales yourself, are uncomfortable chasing payments, or need constant hand-holding on repetitive admin tasks.



—



2. What You'll Actually Do (First 6 Months)



Daily tasks (70% of role):



- Send WhatsApp reminders to B2B clients for outstanding payments and reorder prompts



- Manage the payment reminder sequence system to ensure no client slips through



- Send order confirmation and acknowledgement messages to clients after every order



- Raise, send, and track invoices for all B2B wholesale transactions



- Follow through on accounts receivable — monitor outstanding invoices and escalate to the AE when needed



- Handle new account onboarding admin tasks (forms, welcome messages, documentation)



- Keep all CRM records and Trello pipeline cards up-to-date and accurate



- Provide admin support to the Account Executive (handler support, document prep, scheduling)



Documentation tasks (30% of role):



- Transcribe video-recorded processes into written SOPs using our documentation template



- Create and organize SOP pages following our established SOP format



- Build Trello task cards for each workflow step and link to corresponding SOPs



- Maintain and update existing SOPs as processes evolve



- Support async onboarding infrastructure so new hires can self-serve training materials



What you're learning while doing this:



- How B2B wholesale sales and accounts receivable operations work end-to-end



- Working directly with an Account Executive and senior leadership



- Building reliable systems for client communication and payment follow-through



- Beginning to own one specific function based on your strengths (AR, onboarding admin, CRM ops)



3. Our Career System (Why This Is Different)



We have a 5-level mastery system for all team members:



L2 (Junior) ? You start here | $350-400/month



L3 (Senior) ? Most reach in 6-12 months | $600-800/month + profit sharing



L4 (Lead) | $1,000-1,500/month + profit sharing



L5 (Principal) | $2,000+/month + profit sharing



How promotions work: When you're ready, you request it. You hire and train your replacement. Pass = promoted. Don't pass = return to current level with clear feedback, try again in 6 months.



First 90 days: Trial period for both of us. Frequent feedback, fair warnings if things aren't working.



—



4. Who Gets Promoted



Beyond doing good work, we look for:



- Self-directed: "Manager of one" mentality



- Strong communicator: Can write clearly and professionally—you'll be representing the company to B2B clients (this is non-negotiable)



- Zero-errors mindset: Invoices, payment reminders, and order confirmations must be accurate every time



- Obsessed learner: Can teach yourself new tools and processes in months, not years



- Brings solutions: Not just problems



- Detail-oriented: Nothing falls through the cracks—client orders, CRM updates, documentation accuracy



- Business-minded: Genuinely curious about how B2B sales and operations work



- Systems thinker: Naturally sees inefficiencies and documents processes to scale



Our philosophy: "Income is a byproduct of who you become." We're building people, not just filling seats.



—



5. Requirements



Must have:



- Advanced English (speaking, reading, writing)—you'll communicate with B2B clients professionally



- Strong attention to detail (managing client orders and quotes requires zero errors)



- Reliable internet + dedicated workspace



- Can learn new tools quickly (Take.App, Trello, Google Workspace)



- Process-oriented mindset—you enjoy creating order from chaos



- Comfortable with repetitive but high-stakes follow-up tasks



- Comfortable working cross-functionally with sales team and other departments



Nice to have:



- Additional languages (Burmese, Mandarin, Thai, Tagalog, Vietnamese)



- Previous accounts receivable, B2B admin, or sales support experience



- CRM or project management tool experience (We use Take.App and Trello)



- Familiarity with invoicing workflows or accounting tools



Location:



- This is a fully remote role



- Only looking for candidates in China, Taiwan, Hong Kong, Indonesia, Malaysia, Vietnam, Thailand, Myanmar, and Philippines



- Do not apply if you are not living in these countries above





—



6. Compensation



Starting (L2):



- Base: Expected to pay USD$350/month (At 176 hours/month, 9.30am to 6.30pm GMT+08, Mon-Fri, excluding public holidays)



- Bonus: Up to $50/month (At this level for outstanding performance)



Independence: Our VAs operate on a clock in-clock out basis, so you will have complete control over your hours, work remotely as long as projects and task deadlines are met without delay.



—



7. How to Apply




: 
 "L2 VA Application - [Your Name]"



Send:



- Your Resume, CV, Portfolio...etc



- Upload a three-minute (maximum) video of yourself answering a few simple questions:?

"Why are you interested in this position?"?

Process: Screen (3 days) ? 1st Interview with your Leader (45 min) ? 2nd Interview with Founder (45 min) ? Decision (2 days)



—



8. Quick FAQs



Q: Is $350/month enough??A: It's entry-level pay for entry-level work. Prove you can become a manager-of-one, and you will succeed in this company.



Q: Will I actually get promoted??A: We have objective criteria and promote from within. You control your growth.



Q: What if I'm not good at everything??A: There will be training provided. As long as you are curious, and willing to learn, there is no problem. Our policy on this is make every mistake in the book, but don't make them twice.



Q: Will I be doing actual sales??A: No. You handle all the admin so our Account Executives can focus on selling. If you want to do sales, this isn't the right role. But you'll learn how B2B sales operations work, which is valuable if you want to move into sales ops or account management later.



Q: Do I need to know Take.App or Trello already??A: No. We'll train you. As long as you can learn new tools quickly and follow structured processes, you'll be fine.

title: AI Tool Researcher
description:
Location: Fully Remote (Philippines)

We are hiring an AI Tool Researcher to help our company stay at the forefront of the rapidly evolving AI landscape. This role is equal parts researcher, power user, internal educator, and productivity optimizer.



Your job is not just to read about AI tools—but to discover them early, test them deeply, and translate their real-world value into practical use cases for our teams across product, engineering, video, operations, and leadership.



AI is moving fast. New tools, agents, and workflows appear weekly. This role exists to make sure we don’t fall behind—and more importantly, that we actually use what’s possible. You will work closely with leadership on a daily basis and collaborate with teams across the company to identify where AI can save time, improve quality, or unlock entirely new capabilities.

1. Discover New AI Tools & Products

- AI chatbots and copilots

operations)

- Monitor AI newsletters, communities, and launch platforms (e.g., AI Valley, AI Breakfast, product launches, demos, social media, and forums).

- Identify tools early—before they become mainstream—and assess their relevance to

our business.

Example:

Discovering tools like new AI chatbots, AI-powered negotiation tools, AI research assistants, or emerging agent frameworks and flagging them for internal use.



2. Hands-On Testing & Experimentation

- Personally use and test AI tools to understand:

- What they are actually capable of (not just marketing claims)

- Where they break

- What workflows they truly improve

Explore advanced and creative use cases across areas such as:

- Research and analysis

- Product development and design

- Programming and technical workflows

- Video and content production

- Operations, HR, payroll, and internal processes

- Compare tools against each other and recommend the best option for specific needs.

This role requires curiosity and experimentation. You are expected to “play,” test,

and push tools to their limits.



3. Internal Knowledge Sharing & Enablement

- Create clear, concise Loom videos, walkthroughs, and internal presentations explaining:

- What the tool is

- Why it matters

- How we should use it

- Share findings with leadership and relevant teams in a way that is:

- Practical

- Actionable

- Easy to adopt

- Maintain internal documentation or tool libraries as needed.

Your goal is to translate complexity into clarity for the rest of the company.



4. Team Collaboration & Workflow Optimization

- Meet regularly with tea
mbers across:

- Product

- Engineering

- Video / Creative

- Operations

- Leadership

- Understand what each team is doing today and identify:

- Where AI could speed things up

- Where AI could improve quality

- Where AI could enable entirely new workflows

- Recommend specific tools, agents, or processes tailored to each role.

Example:

Helping video editors discover better AI UGC tools, helping engineers explore new coding or agent-based workflows, or helping operations teams automate spreadsheets and reporting.



5. AI Agents & Future-Facing Workflows

- Research and experiment with AI agents and multi-step automation.

- Explore how AI agents could be used for:

- Research

- Product iteration

- Operations

- Internal tooling

- Help leadership think strategically about how AI should be embedded into how we

build products and run the company.



Who You Are

- Extremely curious and self-directed

- Comfortable learning new tools constantly

- Excited by experimentation, not intimidated by incomplete documentation

- Able to explain technical or complex concepts in simple terms

- Organized enough to track findings, tools, and recommendations

- Comfortable working closely with leadership

- Strong written and verbal English communication skills



Required Skills & Experience

- Strong interest in AI, automation, and emerging technology

- Experience using modern AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude/Opus, copilots, AI SaaS tools)

- Ability to research independently and synthesize insights

- Experience creating Loom videos, demos, or internal presentations (or willingness to learn quickly)

- Comfortable working a graveyard shift aligned with US-based teams



Nice to Have (But Not Required)

- Experience testing beta products or early-stage tools

- Familiarity with AI agents, automation platforms, or no-code tools

- Experience working with distributed or remote teams



Why This Role Matters

This role directly impacts:

- Company productivity

- Product quality

- Speed of execution

- Competitive advantage



AI is no longer optional. The AI Tool Researcher ensures we are not just aware of what’s happening—but actively leveraging it.

title: Mobile App QA Tester / Bug Reporter
description:
We're looking for an experienced mobile app developer to serve as a QA tester. The testing itself is not a paid task however depending on if it needs to be fixed, that is what determines if you will be hired of not. 



Your role is NOT to build features. You'll be going through the app end-to-end as a power user and documenting everything that's broken, confusing, missing, or needs improvement. Think of yourself as a highly technical critic. 



What you'll do:

- Test all core flows: onboarding, dashboard, campaigns, messaging, profile setup, payments/payouts, and any other screens accessible

- Document every bug, broken UI element, confusing UX pattern, and missing functionality

- Note device/OS/browser for each issue

- Prioritize issues by severity (critical / major / minor / cosmetic)

- Deliver a clean, organized report (Google Doc or Notion) with screenshots or screen recordings where relevant



What we're looking for:

- Experience building or testing mobile apps (iOS and/or Android)

- Strong eye for UX — you know what "good" looks like

- Detail-oriented and thorough — nothing should slip through

- Comfortable writing clear, structured reports in English

- Familiarity with creator platforms, freelance marketplaces, or social apps is a plus



From the things you find, if it needs to be fixed, you will be hired for it. You must be experienced.

title: Web Operations Specialist
description:
GROWING AUSTRALIAN WEB DESIGN AGENCY



This is a developing role within a growing agency. Your responsibilities will evolve as we scale, and we're looking for someone who's energised by that, not unsettled by it.



ABOUT THE ROLE

You'll be the operational backbone of our web builds. You'll work alongside our outsourced developer, taking projects from the build phase through to launch and ongoing optimisation. You're detail-oriented, process-driven, and you thrive when systems run smoothly.



YOUR DAY-TO-DAY WILL INCLUDE

- Configure WordPress environments on SiteGround for outsourced developers, ensuring clean handoff and security protocols.

- Build new WordPress sites using Elementor, working from HTML mockups and our existing templates and SOPs. As the role develops, identify opportunities to create new templates and refine existing processes.

- Manage live site tweaks, design refinements, SEO optimisation, and plugin configuration post-launch.

- Oversee site migrations to new domains, manage DNS, SSL certificates, and hosting configurations.

- Execute ongoing SEO work including on-page optimisation, schema implementation (nice-to-have), and technical SEO audits.

- Create and maintain SOPs and process documentation (written guides and Loom videos) to systematise your work and support team scaling.

- Handle administrative tasks including client communication, invoicing support, and basic business operations when build queue allows.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Strong WordPress knowledge with hands-on experience building and troubleshooting sites.

- Familiarity with Elementor/Hello theme and Astra/Spectra 

- Experience with plug ins, online forms and integrations (Elementor native forms, WP mail STMP) and experience integrating  booking solutions into client websites (Amelia, Calendly, or similar)

- Solid understanding of hosting, domains, DNS, SSL, and basic server management.

- Detail-oriented with a genuine interest in systems and processes.

- Excellent written communication in English.

- Ability to work independently and manage your own time within agreed hours.

- A growth mindset - you're comfortable learning new tools and adapting as the business evolves.



Nice-to-haves (not essential):

SEO experience, schema markup knowledge, extensive plug in knowledge for higher end sites, CRM integration knowledge, Automation experience (workflow - to connect forms, bookings and business tools)



ABOUT YOU

You're process-driven and detail-focused. You enjoy documenting how things work. You communicate clearly, ask good questions when instructions are ambiguous, and you follow through. You're reliable, honest, and you want to be part of something that's building.



We're a small, family-oriented business. We value people who share that ethos - people who care about doing good work and building something sustainable.



THE ROLE IN NUMBERS

Full-time: 40 hours per week, ideally 7am-4pm Manila time (9am-6pm AEST Brisbane time). Partial overlap is fine.

Salary: PHP 40,000 starting, with review at end of probation (3 months) and annually thereafter. The range is PHP 40,000-60,000 depending on experience and growth.



Benefits: 

13th month pay (standard in Philippines). Health insurance (HMO) available.

Start date: Ideally within 4-6 weeks. Flexible for the right person.



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

We'll review applications as they come in and will only contact shortlisted candidates. If you don't hear from us this round, thank you for applying, and please consider applying again as new opportunities open up. We're taking our time to find the right person, so the hiring process may move quickly or slowly depending on the applications we receive.

Shortlisted candidates may be asked to complete a 16Personalities assessment (free, takes 12 minutes) as part of our screening process. We also use paid DISC profiling for final candidates at our cost.



APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS

To apply, please include in your application:



- Your CV and links to 3 live WordPress sites you've built or significantly contributed to launching.

- A brief written response (2-3 sentences) to this question: Tell us about a process or system you improved at a previous job, and how you documented it.

- Your 16Personalities result (take the free test at 
 and paste your profile type and key insights).

- A short Loom video (3-5 minutes max) walking us through one of the WordPress sites you've built - what you did, why you made certain choices, and what you'd do differently now. This shows us how you think and communicate.



In your
 subject line, include the phrase "I understand the role is developing" so we know you've read this properly.





We're looking forward to hearing from you.

description:
About TruDOQ

TruDOQ is a simple, secure, and fast digital signing tool built for the modern era of business. We’ve solved the biggest flaw in digital agreements by attaching a photo to every signature, adding a vital layer of security and identity verification. We are a lean, results-driven startup looking for a professional who values honesty, independence, and the challenge of scaling a high-potential product.



The Role

We are looking for an Outbound Cold Calling Specialist who is a natural "hunter." You will be responsible for reaching out to business owners and decision-makers in the US to introduce them to the security and simplicity of TruDOQ. Your goal is to get them to see the value in photo-verified signatures and invite them to use the platform.



Key Responsibilities

- Outbound Prospecting: Conduct high-volume cold calls to US companies during their business hours.

- Effective Pitching: Communicate TruDOQ’s unique value—specifically how our photo-verification prevents fraud and adds trust to digital contracts.

- Lead Conversion: Drive sign-ups and schedule demos with interested prospects.

- Independent Management: We do not micromanage. You are expected to manage your time, hit your targets, and maintain a high level of activity autonomously.

- Reporting & Integrity: Provide honest, accurate daily reports on call volume and lead status.



Technical & Workspace Requirements (Non-Negotiable)

To ensure a professional experience for our US clients, you must meet the following:

- Hardware: A reliable PC/Laptop (Core i5 or higher preferred) with at least 8GB RAM.

- Audio: A dedicated Noise-Canceling Headset (e.g., Jabra, Plantronics, or similar).

- Internet: A stable, high-speed fiber connection (minimum 25 Mbps) with a backup power/internet solution.

- Environment: A dedicated, private home office space that is 100% free from background noise (no barking dogs, traffic, or crowing chickens).



What We’re Looking For

- Shift Availability: Strictly willing and able to work the Night Shift to align with US Business Hours (Eastern or Pacific Time).

- The Voice: Fluent English with a clear, neutral American accent. You must be comfortable engaging in high-level business conversations.

- Experience: Previous experience in outbound cold calling or B2B sales.

- Mindset: Entrepreneurial and self-starting. You don’t wait for instructions; you find ways to get the "Yes."

- Character: Uncompromising integrity. You do the work with 100% honesty and transparency.

- Equipment: Reliable computer, noise-canceling headset, and a stable, high-speed internet connection.



Why Join TruDOQ?

- Early Team Role: Help build and scale a startup from the ground up.

- Remote-First: Work from home with a focus on results, not hours logged.

- Straightforward Product: Pitch a tool that is easy to understand and solves a real security problem.

- Growth: Opportunity for bonuses based on performance and lead quality.



To Apply:

Please send the following two items:

1. Resume or LinkedIn Profile

2. Equipment List: Briefly list your PC/Laptop specs (RAM/Processor), your headset model (must be noise-canceling), and your internet speed.

title: Advertorial & Native Ad Specialist — Copywriting + Visual AI (Ecommerce US)
description:
We're a US-based ecommerce brand scaling cordless tools to American homeowners aged 55-75. We're looking for ONE long-term native ad specialist who can independently produce winning advertorials and listicles from start to finish.



WHAT YOU'LL DO:



Every week, you'll receive a brief from us with the angle, product, and target audience. Within 48 hours, you'll deliver a complete advertorial page ready to publish, including:



1. WRITING: 7-item listicles or advertorials in the style of Lulutox, HairMagic+, Elycura, BluHat — direct response copywriting that ranks on Meta cold traffic. Hooks, headlines, body paragraphs, CTAs.



2. AI VISUALS: Generate all images and videos using Nano Banana Pro, Higgsfield, Kling, Sora, or similar tools. You know how to prompt for photorealistic, native-ad-style imagery — NOT generic AI looks. Hand-pick references, iterate to perfection.



3. PAGE BUILDING: Publish the final page on Ecomwise (similar to ClickFunnels). You'll learn this tool fast — we'll train you on day 1.



4. EDITING & QA: Catch typos, factual errors, copy inconsistencies before publishing. Proofread like a hawk.



5. ITERATION: When we send feedback, you respond and adjust quickly without ego.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE:



— 2+ years writing direct response copy for US ecommerce brands (you should be able to share at least 3 advertorials you've written)

— Native or near-native English with strong feel for American senior demographic voice

— Hands-on experience with AI image/video generation tools (Midjourney, DALL-E, Nano Banana, Higgsfield, Kling, Sora — at least 3 of these)

— Familiarity with landing page builders (ClickFunnels, Shogun, Ecomwise, Replo, or similar)

— Strong understanding of native advertorial format: Lulutox, HairMagic+, Elycura, Magic Mind, Native Path style

— Familiarity with copywriters like Eugene Schwartz, Gary Halbert, and modern direct response practitioners (Mark Builds Brands, RTM, etc.) is a major plus



WHAT WE OFFER:



— Stable full-time role with weekly briefs and clear deliverables

— Long-term engagement (12+ months) with growing scope as we scale

— Direct work with the founder — fast decisions, no corporate layers

— Performance bonuses on winning campaigns (assets that convert get rewarded)

— Mentorship on advanced copywriting frameworks (Schwartz Awareness Levels, Sophistication Stages, Disguise Marketing)



HOW TO APPLY:



Send us:

1. Your 3 best advertorials/listicles (links or PDFs) — written by YOU, for ECOMMERCE products targeting US audiences

2. 2-3 AI-generated images you produced for ad use (with the prompt you used)

3. A 200-word answer to this question: "Why do most cordless leaf blowers fail seniors over 60?" — show us your direct response copy thinking



We're looking for ONE person, not an agency. Quality over quantity. Apply only if you can commit to consistent, high-output work.

You will own your pipeline end to end. That means building your own presence, your own relationships, and your own commercial reputation – using LinkedIn and digital outreach as your primary tools. Where in-person meetings are required, our UK-based Sales Manager will step in to support.

The deals you will be working are not small. Each closed partnership represents life-changing commission.

, and digital channels

 • Maintain accurate pipeline and deal progression reporting directly to the Founder

 • Work alongside the marketing team to align outreach with active campaigns

Who You Are

 • You have significant, proven experience in commercial sales within beauty, aesthetics, or medical beauty – this is non-negotiable

 • You have an active, credible LinkedIn presence and are comfortable building your personal brand as part of your sales strategy

 • You are confident selling high-value B2B propositions – clinic software, devices, franchise models, or training partnerships

 • You are self-directed and can build and manage a pipeline without daily supervision

Basic Salary

OTE: ?11,250,000+ per year (equivalent to £150,000+) – uncapped for high performers



How to Apply

Send your CV, a brief note on your most relevant commercial deal to date, and your LinkedIn profile URL. Applications without proven aesthetics or medical beauty industry experience will not be reviewed.

title: Operations & Customer Success Manager — Premium D2C Brand (Long-Term Right Hand Role)
description:
We are a fast-growing premium D2C brand based in the Netherlands, selling to clients across Europe, the UK, the US, and the Middle East. We are looking for one person to become the operational right hand of our two founders. This is not a task-taker role. This is a build-with-us role.

You will own the full customer journey from lead to repeat buyer, and you will own the operational backbone that keeps that journey running.

What you will be responsible for

Lead and customer management. Every lead that comes in from
 and Google is yours. You qualify them, you build the relationship, you guide them toward purchasing a sample, and you follow up until they convert into a bulk order. You work inside our cadence and our tone of voice. You do not push. You build trust.

Sample-to-bulk conversion. Once a sample is on the way, you own the follow-up. Tracking updates, arrival check-ins, experience check-ins, and the conversation that moves them from sample to bulk. You schedule short calls with the founders when needed.

Supply chain oversight. You monitor all outgoing shipments. When a delivery is not moving smoothly, you take action. You communicate with our third-party logistics partners, last-mile carriers, and the customer to keep things on track. Nothing slips through.

Customer retention. After delivery, you check in. You make sure everything arrived in good condition. You build the relationship that turns a one-time buyer into a repeat client.

Supplier coordination. You join our supplier group chats and our Shopify backend. You make sure every order is fulfilled on time. If something is off, you flag it with the supplier directly. You also monitor stock levels and raise concerns before they become problems.

What we expect from you

Fluent, near-native written English. Our brand voice is calm, premium, and confident. You must be able to write that way naturally.

Customer-facing sales experience. You have done outbound or inbound sales before. You understand how to move a conversation forward without being pushy. Copywriting experience is a strong plus.

Extreme responsiveness. This is non-negotiable. You are at your screen during working hours. You reply fast. You do not let conversations go cold. If you know you are not someone who lives near your laptop and responds within minutes, this role is not for you.

Working hours that overlap with the Netherlands, roughly 08:00 to 16:00 NL time. Full-time, 40+ hours per week.

Comfort with digital tools. We work in 
, Gmail, WeChat, Shopify, and our own custom software. We will train you on everything. What matters is that you learn fast and stay organized.

Ownership mentality. You think one step ahead. You spot problems before we do. You bring solutions, not questions.

What we offer

A base rate of 2 to 4 USD per hour depending on experience, paid weekly or biweekly. On top of that, we offer sales bonuses that can add several hundred dollars per month based on conversions and bulk orders you close.

More importantly, this is a long-term position. You grow with us. As we scale, your responsibilities, your compensation, and your role grow with the company. We are looking for someone who wants to be here in two years, not someone looking for a short gig.

Direct access to the founders. You will work side by side with us. You will see how a premium brand is built from the inside.

How to apply

Send a short message telling us:



Why this role fits you specifically.

Your experience with customer-facing sales or account management.

A short writing sample. One paragraph in English replying to a hypothetical customer who has just received a sample and is hesitant to place a bulk order.

Confirm you can work 40+ hours per week aligned with NL business hours.

Start your message with the ???? emoji so we know you read the full description.



We start with a paid trial week. If it clicks on both sides, we move into a long-term agreement immediately.

We are hiring ASAP.

title: WordPress Developer — Skin Training professional Platform
description:
About the Role

Skin United is a professional skin science education platform built by The Beauté Group. We are in an intensive build phase ahead of our August 2026 launch and need an experienced WordPress developer to join the team on a freelance or contract basis.

This role is specifically for the 
 professional platform. We have separate developers already working on our consumer app build, so this role is focused entirely on the WordPress website — building, designing, and launching it correctly and on time.

You will work alongside our web development supervisor, automation specialist, and report directly to the Founder and CEO. We move fast and expect the same.



The Stack

WordPress, Tutor LMS Pro, WooCommerce, Elementor Pro, Hello Elementor parent theme.



What You Will Be Working On

We need a developer who can take ownership of the full WordPress build. This includes designing and implementing the front end to match our brand (full brand guidelines will be provided), setting up and configuring Tutor LMS Pro correctly, and ensuring the platform is stable, performant, and ready for commercial launch.

We currently have a WordPress installation with the plugin stack in place. There are a number of issues that need resolving as part of the build:

Tutor LMS template overrides are not loading correctly and need to be debugged and confirmed as working. The single course page and course archive layouts are not rendering as intended. There are conflicts between Elementor Pro and the Tutor LMS template system that need diagnosing and resolving. Custom CSS is not applying correctly in places due to specificity conflicts with Elementor and Tutor LMS default styles. The WooCommerce checkout, cart, and My Account pages need to be built, styled, and tested end to end including course access gating via purchase and Tutor LMS enrolment. Known bugs on the single course page, curriculum accordion (Safari), and student dashboard need resolving. Mobile responsiveness needs a full build and audit across all pages. Caching configuration needs reviewing to ensure Tutor LMS dynamic pages are excluded.



Ongoing Responsibilities

Once the platform is built and launched, ongoing work includes maintaining and updating the site as new courses are added, supporting WooCommerce payment flows (Klarna, Clearpay, Stripe), ensuring the membership tier system (Starter, Professional, Clinic) connects correctly to course access in Tutor LMS, and making sure non-technical tea
mbers can manage content cleanly. You will also work closely with our automation specialist to ensure CRM and webhook integrations connect correctly with the platform.



What We Need From You

You must have real hands-on Tutor LMS Pro experience from an actual project. Please do not apply if your LMS experience is with LearnDash, LifterLMS, or similar platforms only and you have not worked with Tutor LMS directly.

You must be confident with WordPress theme development, front-end design implementation, and translating brand guidelines into a polished, professional website. You need to be comfortable with PHP, WordPress hooks and filters, CSS, and troubleshooting plugin conflicts.

Strong WooCommerce experience is required including checkout customisation, subscription products, and access gating. Elementor Pro experience is required including managing conflicts between Elementor and custom theme templates.

It is a bonus if you have experience with automation tool integrations (we use Zoho), Stripe payment setup, or building education and membership platforms.

title: Part time Video Editor – Meta Ad Creatives
description:
Who we are

We're a growing Dutch online fragrance (family) brand scaling ads on Meta. We're hiring a video editor for stable, long-term weekly collaboration.



What you'll do

You'll edit two core formats:

1) Mainly: Compilation videos: We provide a script. You source matching clips from our footage library, create voice-over, and assemble into a punchy, scroll-stopping ad (15 sec - 2 min.).

2) UGC-style videos: Edit raw UGC footage into authentic, lo-fi short-form content.



Each video takes 45–60 minutes. No complex effects needed: clean, fast cuts that work.

Weekly workflow



Wednesday: we film

Same day: you receive raw footage + written brief (3–5 videos per batch)

End of week: deliver finished videos



Communication: written brief only, calls only for long term plan. 



What we're looking for

Core requirements:

- 2–3 portfolio links (short-form social ads preferred)

- Reliable weekly deadline delivery

- Skilled with CapCut, Premiere Pro, or equivalent

- Able to follow written English briefs

- Experience inserting image overlays (review screenshots, product cards)



Strong advantages:

- Experience editing UGC videos

- Comfortable working with AI tools and AI-generated UGC (we actively encourage AI use when quality is maintained)



How to apply

Include in your message:

- Start with the word "GEUR" (attention check—shows you read this carefully)

- Answer in 2–3 sentences: What's one editing technique you always use to make short video more engaging?

- 2–3 portfolio links

- Brief intro: who are you, how long editing?

- Available hours per week

- 5 brands/stores you've worked for

- List your capabilities: Compilation / UGC / AI-UGC

- Specify: How much AI do you use in your workflow? Which tools?

Applications missing these details will not be reviewed.



Pay & trial

$4–$6 per finished video. (40-60 bi-weekly typical).

Paid bi-weekly, on time, always.



Top applicants invited to a paid trial week: 3 real briefs, 3 real videos, review together.

Next steps

We're testing fit first. If it works for both of us, we move to consistent weekly work with better rates over time.
